description_good_justification: The README and the project site say what it does: a π (pi) coding-agent extension that blocks edits to files that changed since the agent read them, snapshots the project before each run so /undo restores it exactly, and stops repeated identical tool calls. https://github.com/jlrrequina/pi-edit-guard#readme
interact_justification: The README gives the install command (pi install npm:@lenard9191/pi-edit-guard) and links the issue tracker and CONTRIBUTING.md; bugs and feature requests go through GitHub issue templates, changes through pull requests. https://github.com/jlrrequina/pi-edit-guard#readme
contribution_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md: issues and pull requests on GitHub, the checks that must pass, the changelog entry. https://github.com/jlrrequina/pi-edit-guard/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
contribution_requirements_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md and AGENTS.md list the requirements: erasable TypeScript only, no runtime dependencies, never write into the project or its .git, npm run check and npm test pass, a test that fails without the change, a changelog entry. https://github.com/jlrrequina/pi-edit-guard/blob/main/AGENTS.md
floss_license_osi_justification: MIT is approved by the OSI.
license_location_justification: LICENSE at the root of the repository. https://github.com/jlrrequina/pi-edit-guard/blob/main/LICENSE
documentation_basics_justification: The README covers installation, the guarantees, how it works, commands, coverage, configuration, secrets and compatibility. https://github.com/jlrrequina/pi-edit-guard#readme
documentation_interface_justification: The README documents the whole external interface: the messages the agent sees, the /undo, /checkpoints and /guard commands, every configuration key with its default, and the debug log. https://github.com/jlrrequina/pi-edit-guard#commands
sites_https_justification: The repository (github.com), the package (npmjs.com, registry.npmjs.org) and the site (jlrrequina.github.io) are served over HTTPS only.
discussion_justification: GitHub issues and pull requests: searchable, each topic has a URL, open to anyone with a GitHub account. https://github.com/jlrrequina/pi-edit-guard/issues
english_justification: Documentation, issues and code comments are in English.
maintained_justification: Actively maintained: commits and releases, and scheduled weekly CodeQL, OpenSSF Scorecard, host-compatibility and public-repository runs. https://github.com/jlrrequina/pi-edit-guard/commits/main
repo_track_justification: Git records what changed, who changed it and when.
repo_interim_justification: Every change is committed to main between releases; a release is a tag on main.
version_unique_justification: Each release has a unique version: package.json, the git tag vX.Y.Z and the npm version.
version_semver_justification: Semantic Versioning; the Release workflow takes patch, minor or major from the changelog heading.
version_tags_justification: Each release is the git tag vX.Y.Z; a repository ruleset blocks updating or deleting release tags. https://github.com/jlrrequina/pi-edit-guard/tags
release_notes_justification: CHANGELOG.md has a section for each release, and the same text is the body of the GitHub release. https://github.com/jlrrequina/pi-edit-guard/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
release_notes_vulns_justification: No release has fixed a publicly known vulnerability yet. SECURITY.md: the notes of the release that fixes a vulnerability name its advisory and CVE. https://github.com/jlrrequina/pi-edit-guard/blob/main/SECURITY.md
report_process_justification: GitHub issues with bug and feature templates. https://github.com/jlrrequina/pi-edit-guard/issues/new/choose
report_responses_justification: No bug report has been submitted yet.
enhancement_responses_justification: No enhancement request has been submitted yet.
report_archive_justification: GitHub issues are public and searchable. https://github.com/jlrrequina/pi-edit-guard/issues?q=is%3Aissue
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: SECURITY.md: report privately through GitHub private vulnerability reporting; first response within 7 days. https://github.com/jlrrequina/pi-edit-guard/blob/main/SECURITY.md
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: GitHub private vulnerability reporting is on; SECURITY.md links it. https://github.com/jlrrequina/pi-edit-guard/security/advisories/new
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: No vulnerability has been reported in the last 6 months. SECURITY.md commits to a first response within 7 days.
build_justification: Nothing is built: π loads the TypeScript sources directly (erasable syntax only). The Release workflow packs the published tarball from the tagged commit with npm pack.
build_common_tools_justification: No build step. Packaging and checks use npm and the TypeScript compiler.
build_floss_tools_justification: No build step. Node.js, npm, TypeScript and git, which pack and check the package, are FLOSS.
test_justification: npm test runs the automated suite (node:test): unit, property-based (fast-check), integration and in-π tests. README and CONTRIBUTING.md document it. https://github.com/jlrrequina/pi-edit-guard/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
test_most_justification: CI fails below 92% line, 84% branch and 90% function coverage. https://github.com/jlrrequina/pi-edit-guard/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: GitHub Actions run the typecheck and the tests on Linux, macOS and Windows with Node 22.18, 24 and 26, and against the oldest supported π, for every pull request and every push to main. https://github.com/jlrrequina/pi-edit-guard/actions
test_policy_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md: every change in behavior comes with a test that fails without it. https://github.com/jlrrequina/pi-edit-guard/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
tests_are_added_justification: Changes come with their tests, for example the symlink-safe restore with 71 lines in test/snapshot.test.ts. https://github.com/jlrrequina/pi-edit-guard/commit/a864df3ad37a44027f7a709cd18aeacfffbdaf38
tests_documented_added_justification: The test policy is in CONTRIBUTING.md, the instructions for change proposals. https://github.com/jlrrequina/pi-edit-guard/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
warnings_justification: TypeScript in strict mode with erasableSyntaxOnly and verbatimModuleSyntax (tsconfig.json); actionlint and zizmor lint the workflows in CI.
warnings_fixed_justification: npm run check (tsc) must be clean; CI fails on any error.
crypto_published_justification: The only cryptographic function is SHA-256 from node:crypto (content hashes to detect file changes), plus git's object hashing in the private snapshot store. Both are published and reviewed.
crypto_call_justification: Hashes come from node:crypto and git; nothing cryptographic is implemented in the project.
crypto_working_justification: No security mechanism depends on cryptography: SHA-256 detects changed files, and git's object IDs address content in a local private store; neither authenticates anything.
crypto_weaknesses_justification: No security mechanism depends on cryptography (see crypto_working).
crypto_random_justification: No cryptographic keys or nonces are generated.
delivery_mitm_justification: Delivered from the npm registry over HTTPS; each release has npm provenance and a Sigstore-signed build attestation, and the GitHub release is immutable. https://github.com/jlrrequina/pi-edit-guard/blob/main/SECURITY.md
delivery_unsigned_justification: No hash is fetched over HTTP. npm checks the tarball against the integrity hash from the registry over HTTPS; npm audit signatures and gh attestation verify check signatures.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: No known unpatched vulnerability: no advisories and no open Dependabot alerts; the package has no runtime dependencies.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: No critical vulnerability has been reported. SECURITY.md: fixes ship as a patch release.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: The repository holds no credentials: npm publishing uses trusted publishing (OIDC) with no token, and GitHub secret scanning with push protection is on.
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL (security-and-quality queries for JavaScript/TypeScript and GitHub Actions) runs on every push to main, every pull request and weekly; zizmor and actionlint audit the workflows in CI. https://github.com/jlrrequina/pi-edit-guard/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL's security-and-quality suite looks for common vulnerabilities: injection, path traversal, insecure temporary files, file-system races, insecure workflows.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: Every alert is triaged. No alert is open in the published code; three alerts in test-only code (test/helpers.ts, scripts/corpus.ts) were reviewed and dismissed as used in tests.
static_analysis_often_justification: On every push to main, every pull request and weekly.
dynamic_analysis_justification: Property-based tests with fast-check (300 random trees and mutations per run; restore and redo must be exact), snapshot and restore of nine public repositories (npm run corpus, weekly in CI), and a CI floor of 84% branch coverage.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: Written in TypeScript, a memory-safe language.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: The tests and the property test run with node:assert assertions on every case.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: Defects found by the property test, the corpus and CI on three operating systems are fixed before a release; none is open.
osps_ac_03_01_justification: main accepts direct pushes from the maintainer and from the Release workflow, which pushes the release commit. A repository ruleset blocks force pushes and deletion of main.
osps_ac_03_02_justification: A repository ruleset blocks deletion of the default branch.
osps_br_01_01_justification: Workflows read untrusted metadata (branch names, inputs) only through environment variables, never interpolated into scripts; zizmor checks this in CI. https://github.com/jlrrequina/pi-edit-guard/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
osps_br_01_03_justification: Pull-request workflows get no secrets and only the permissions they need (read, plus security-events: write for CodeQL's upload); no workflow uses pull_request_target; the npm environment deploys only from main and v* tags.
osps_br_03_01_justification: Every official channel uses HTTPS: github.com, npmjs.com, pi.dev and jlrrequina.github.io.
osps_br_03_02_justification: Distribution through the npm registry over HTTPS, with npm provenance and a Sigstore-signed attestation for each release.
osps_br_07_01_justification: GitHub secret scanning with push protection is on, and releases need no secret (trusted publishing).
osps_do_01_01_justification: The README is the user guide for every function: freshness, snapshots and /undo, the loop breaker, commands and configuration. https://github.com/jlrrequina/pi-edit-guard#readme
osps_do_02_01_justification: The bug report template asks what happened and what was expected, for the output (/guard, the message, the debug log) and for the versions. https://github.com/jlrrequina/pi-edit-guard/issues/new/choose
osps_le_03_02_justification: LICENSE is in the npm tarball, which is also attached to each GitHub release.
osps_qa_01_02_justification: The public git history records every change, its author and its time.
osps_qa_02_01_justification: package.json declares the direct dependencies (none at runtime, π as a peer, the development tools) and package-lock.json pins them.
osps_qa_05_01_justification: The repository holds no generated executables.
osps_qa_05_02_justification: The only binary file is docs/cover.png, an image rendered from docs/cover.html.
osps_vm_02_01_justification: SECURITY.md names the private channel for security reports. https://github.com/jlrrequina/pi-edit-guard/blob/main/SECURITY.md
